note: CLEAN START (captain, 2026-10-02): the demo people and records are REMOVED. `prospects`, `clients`, `appointments`, `tasks`, `applications`, `prospect_activity`, `prospect_shares` and the commission statement are empty; the pipeline starts from a lead the agent captures. The office's reference data (the agent identity, the quick actions, the marketing material links, the lot-availability rows and the unconfigured commission vocabulary) is kept.
Fixture data for the agent portal (Module: finance-billing §16-21 agent dashboard + commission engine; crm-cases lead/customer; commerce-catalog §33 pipeline; facilities-scheduling §35 appointments).

THE DEMO HOUSEHOLD (client-cory) IS DERIVED, NOT COPIED: its fixture row carries only agent-only fields plus `household_ref`; its name, phone, email, each loved one's plan, money, lot, the office-released papers and the visits are read at render time from the family's own record (lib/fixtures/family/snapshot.json and workspace.json) by lib/api-client/agent.ts, so the family portal and the agent portal cannot tell two stories. A paper still being checked is not among the released copies (familyDocumentReleased). tests/unit/demo-consistency.test.tsx pins the derivation.

COMMISSION IS UNCONFIGURED BY DESIGN: every commission/target amount is null and `configured` is false — the client has not fixed rates (docs/07-client-villa/open-questions.md:26). Never fill these with invented figures.
Money is integer minor units (`*_cents`) only; views format through lib/money.ts and never parse display strings.
`possible_value_cents` is the full contract value (the 2026 sheet's monthly figure × the term), never a monthly quote — a monthly amount entered as cents reads 100× too small.

`first_contact_at` and `stage_history` are each lead's recorded movement: the first stage is `new` at `first_contact_at`, the last move is where the lead stands and lands on `last_contact_at`, and the dates line up with `prospect_activity` where an entry records the same conversation.

Appointment `starts_at` values are true instants: rendering them through lib/agent/agent-view.ts manilaTime() must reproduce the fixture's own `time_label`; lead-record dates render through manilaDay() the same way.
`example_*` records exist so the review design stays legible; they are labelled as examples in the UI and are not a live record.

CAPTURED LEADS (2026-10-02): a lead captured at /agent/new is written by lib/api-client/agent-store.ts and folded onto this seed by lib/api-client/agent.ts, so a captured person reaches the pipeline, the board and the funnel without editing this file.
